title.zh: Bybit迪拜实体获得VARA颁发的VASP牌照，可进行现货加密货币交易
title.en: Bybit Dubai entity secures VASP license from VARA for spot crypto trading

current_state.zh: Bybit Fintech FZE已获得VARA的VASP牌照，VARA登记显示为active，覆盖现货交易服务；但服务尚未启动，Bybit仍需完成监管启动流程和运营要求，且未公布上线日期。
current_state.en: Bybit Fintech FZE holds an active VARA VASP license covering spot trading services, but the services are not yet launched; Bybit must complete the regulator's launch process and operational requirements, and no launch date has been announced.

updates.title_zh: Bybit迪拜实体获得VARA颁发的VASP牌照，可进行现货加密货币交易
updates.title_en: Bybit Dubai entity secures VASP license from VARA for spot crypto trading
updates.what_changed_zh: Bybit旗下迪拜实体Bybit Fintech FZE获得迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）颁发的虚拟资产服务提供商牌照，涵盖现货加密货币交易，将其2024年的原则性批准转为全面授权。
updates.what_changed_en: Bybit's Dubai entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, obtained a Virtual Asset Service Provider license from Dubai's VARA covering spot crypto trading, converting its 2024 in-principle approval into a full authorization.
updates.current_state_zh: Bybit旗下迪拜实体Bybit Fintech FZE获得迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）颁发的虚拟资产服务提供商牌照，涵盖现货加密货币交易，将其2024年的原则性批准转为全面授权。
updates.current_state_en: Bybit's Dubai entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, obtained a Virtual Asset Service Provider license from Dubai's VARA covering spot crypto trading, converting its 2024 in-principle approval into a full authorization.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bybit's Dubai entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, obtained a Virtual Asset Service Provider license from Dubai's VARA covering spot crypto trading, converting its 2024 in-principle approval into a full authorization.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bybit's Dubai entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, obtained a Virtual Asset Service Provider license from Dubai's VARA covering spot crypto trading, converting its 2024 in-principle approval into a full authorization.

updates.title_zh: Bybit获得迪拜首个现货交易服务全面牌照
updates.title_en: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增信息：该VASP牌照在VARA登记为active，授权面向零售、合格及机构投资者提供现货交易服务，但Bybit仍需完成VARA的启动流程和运营要求后才能开始服务，且未给出上线日期。
updates.what_changed_en: New detail: the VASP license is listed as active on VARA's register and authorizes spot trading services for retail, qualified, and institutional investors, but Bybit must still complete VARA's launch process and operational requirements before starting services; no launch date was provided.
updates.current_state_zh: Bybit Fintech FZE已获得VARA的VASP牌照，VARA登记显示为active，覆盖现货交易服务；但服务尚未启动，Bybit仍需完成监管启动流程和运营要求，且未公布上线日期。
updates.current_state_en: Bybit Fintech FZE holds an active VARA VASP license covering spot trading services, but the services are not yet launched; Bybit must complete the regulator's launch process and operational requirements, and no launch date has been announced.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bybit's Dubai entity received a full VASP license from VARA authorizing spot trading exchange services for retail, qualified, and institutional investors, pending completion of the regulator's launch requirements.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bybit's Dubai entity received a full VASP license from VARA authorizing spot trading exchange services for retail, qualified, and institutional investors, pending completion of the regulator's launch requirements.
